# Gusto

Payroll and HR · options checked 2026-10-27 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Gusto publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

Gusto's own command-line tool (Gusto/gusto-cli) bundles three skills, all indexed: payroll prep and timesheet sync, which stop at a draft payroll you approve in Gusto, and a read-only payroll cash forecast. Agent writes need --confirm.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://mcp.api.gusto.com** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your Gusto account. Gusto's hosted MCP server.
  Not on GitHub, so this index cannot watch it for changes.

## What to use

### From Gusto

- **[Gusto payroll cash forecast](../../skills/gusto-cash-forecasting/README.md)** — Skill · Only reads; changes nothing · needs Gusto CLI, signed in (gusto auth login) · [source](https://github.com/Gusto/gusto-cli/tree/main/src/skills/cash-forecasting)
  Gusto's own skill projecting upcoming payroll cash needs from past payrolls, the general ledger and the pay schedule, split into wages, taxes, benefits and bank debits.
- **[Gusto payroll prep](../../skills/gusto-payroll-prep/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs Gusto CLI, signed in (gusto auth login) · [source](https://github.com/Gusto/gusto-cli/tree/main/src/skills/payroll-prep)
  Gusto's own skill that loads a pay period's hours, tips, commission, bonus and reimbursements from your spreadsheet or POS export onto the draft payroll and calculates it for review.
- **[Gusto timesheet sync](../../skills/gusto-timesheet-sync/README.md)** — Skill · Changes records only after you approve · needs Gusto CLI, signed in (gusto auth login) · [source](https://github.com/Gusto/gusto-cli/tree/main/src/skills/timesheet-sync)
  Gusto's own skill that records a pay period's hours as Gusto time sheets and syncs them into the draft payroll.
